output.review_comment: The implementation is well-structured with three clear, general rules that address common title case requirements: preserving stylized words (Rule 1), properly handling small words with context-aware capitalization (Rule 2), and capitalizing regular words (Rule 3). All reported tests pass, indicating alignment with docstring specifications. Edge cases are handled appropriately, and the code is clean and maintainable. The changes appear to be principled improvements rather than test-specific hacks.
